mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.username FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND (c.parent_id IS NULL OR c.parent_id = 0) AND IFNULL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
SELECT c.*, u.username FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND IFNULL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, parent_id, user_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET likes = #{likes} WHERE id = #{id}
